Writing 3'b111 ensures ROM-Eclipsing happens only after FECSS reset. Orelse it will be a immediate change.
Writing '111' ensures eclipsing of ROM immediately if memswap_wait is not set. If memswap_wait is set then ROM is eclipsed after FECSS reset assertion.
reading 1: confirms ROM is Eclipsed from with RAM for the CPU.

Used to select interrupts going to FECSS IRQ.
